premises.text: Security is the leading smart-home demand but most Americans lack home security
premises.evidence_span: while the majority of Americans, including myself, want to have home security, less than 20% of us actually do

premises.text: Existing home security is complicated to install, not portable, overreactive, and decor-obtrusive
premises.evidence_span: the solutions that are available today are both broken and outdated

premises.text: An all-in-one self-install unit with camera, motion detector, and environmental sensors monitors the home
premises.evidence_span: comes preloaded with a camera, motion detector, and sensors that track your home's environment

premises.text: Mobile app and customizable themes let users personalize monitoring and alerts
premises.evidence_span: being able to customize and make Sentry look and feel as you would want it

premises.text: Sentry connects to and controls third-party devices such as Nest, Philips Hue, and Belkin Wemo
premises.evidence_span: connect and control different devices, including your Nest, Philips Hue light bulb, and a Belkin Wemo smart switch

premises.text: Portable solution targets urban dwellers and pet parents who need security that moves with them
premises.evidence_span: two segments that really popped, which is the urban dweller market as well as pet parents

premises.text: Hardware-as-platform monetizes cloud video recording, media archiving, and Android developer apps
premises.evidence_span: hardware as a platform, where the Sentry unit is just a beginning. We'll also be offering cloud video recording and media archiving services

premises.text: Manufacturing and engineering in Taipei with US go-to-market supports consumer electronics product quality
premises.evidence_span: Our manufacturing and engineering is actually based out of Taipei, the heart of consumer electronics, whereas we're really building our market here in the US

value.text: Simple, elegant home monitoring that protects what matters most
value.evidence_span: monitoring and control for the modern home to help protect what matters most
